name: Seeking the Kor Gem
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing.

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, champion.
narrative.objectives: Bring a Kor Gem to Ulric Frostveil in Ashenvale.
narrative.offerRewardText: You'll no doubt notice the corruption that permeates this gem. For your purposes, The magic needed to dispel the evil that the naga witches have infused into the gem is rather simple. A shame really, there's much one could learn from such powers.I don't suppose you'd be willing to abandon whatever quest caused you seek this gem, and sell it to me instead? It could prove valuable to my... academic pursuits.
narrative.requestItemsText: Kor gems can be used for great acts of evil. Far be it from me to judge if your intentions are pure. It matters not to me.
